description: A UK/European bank export: Windows-1252 bytes (no BOM), semicolon delimiter, 1.234,56 numbers, CRLF line endings.

encodingProof.note: These byte sequences are not valid UTF-8, so strict UTF-8 fails and the Windows-1252 fallback is what makes the file readable.

notes: Read as commas the file also looks consistent, at 3 fields. The semicolon reading is 4 fields wide and wins, which is what keeps 1.234,56 in one cell.
Decimal comma and dot thousands separators are transforms (§6.4), not this task.
